text_block_list.text:
Starting now, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with the Uma Musume in 
charge will begin. And the name of the 
girl I'm walking it with is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is Sakura Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class president, I intend on 
Bakushin-ing all my races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And furthermore, I will win every G1 race 
and set an example for Uma Musume 
everywhere! What an honor-student-like 
idea! I'm afraid of my own brilliant mind! 
my own !

And so began <chrname>'s attempt at the Twinkle 
Series!
